data.name: Avijith
data.gender_notes: Avijith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avijith is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'avij' meaning new and 'jith' meaning born. This name signifies a newborn who is free from the cycle of birth and death. The name Avijith carries the meaning “Newborn, Free from birth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avijith usually hope their child will grow to embody newborn, free from birth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avijith belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Newborn, Free from birth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avijith total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
